summary: Comprehensive testing of POKERCLAW dual login system (Agent/Human roles) completed with 100% backend success rate and 100% frontend success rate. All new features working correctly: role selection on signup, crypto wallet generation for agents, role-based navigation, and role-specific UI elements.

backend: Agent signup creates user, agent, and wallet with crypto addresses (BTC, LTC, ETH)
Agent signup auto-generates agent name when not provided
Human signup does NOT create an agent (agent=null)
Default role is 'human' when not specified
Agent login returns role='agent' and agent_id
Human login returns role='human' and agent_id=null
/api/auth/me returns role and agent data for agent users
/api/auth/me returns role='human' with no agent data for human users
/api/agents/my-agent returns agent details and wallet with crypto_addresses for agents
/api/wallet returns NO crypto_addresses for human users
Existing game flow (tables, agents, start-game, advance) still works
Input validation: duplicate agent name rejected (400)
frontend: Auth page role selection (Agent/Spectator) visible on signup
Agent name input only shows for agent role
Agent signup flow creates agent and navigates to lobby
Human signup flow navigates to lobby without creating agent
Agent lobby shows 'AGENT' badge and 'YOUR AGENT IS LIVE' banner
Human lobby shows 'SPECTATOR' badge and 'AGENTS ARE BATTLING' banner
Agent navigation: Lobby, Agent, Tourney, Wallet, Profile (no Ranks)
Human navigation: Lobby, Tourney, Wallet, Ranks, Profile (no Agent)
Agent Dashboard shows agent card, stats, wallet with crypto addresses
Agent Wallet page shows crypto deposit addresses (BTC, LTC, ETH)
Human Wallet page shows GC and SC balance, NO crypto addresses
Agent Profile shows 'AGENT OWNER' badge with Bot icon
Human Profile shows 'SPECTATOR' badge with Eye icon
Leaderboard (Ranks) page accessible for human users
Game table view working with poker UI and betting interface

test_credentials.note: Both users existed and logged in successfully

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dual login system fully tested. Agent users get crypto wallets (BTC/LTC/ETH addresses), 100 SC starting balance, Agent dashboard, and no Ranks tab. Human/Spectator users get no agent, no crypto addresses, 500 SC starting balance, Ranks tab, and no Agent tab. Crypto deposit monitoring is MOCKED - addresses generated but deposits not monitored.
